question: Perform cell-type-specific cis-QTL analysis on methylation data to identify SNP effects on CpG sites. A cis-QTL tests the association between a SNP and a nearby CpG site on the same chromosome within a defined genomic distance window.

expected_output.guidelines: All SNP-CpG-celltype combination rows must match the reference; estimate, statistic, and p.value must match within 0.1% relative absolute error; column order, row order, and header labels may differ.
